    11	    total: int

    15	        return max(1, ceil(self.total / self.per_page))
    16	
    17	    @property
    18	    def has_next(self) -> bool:
    19	        return self.number < self.pages
    20	
    21	    @property
    22	    def has_prev(self) -> bool:
    23	        return self.number > 1

    26	def paginate(items, page=1, per_page=20):
    27	    """Return the 1-indexed ``page`` of ``items``."""

    30	    if page < 1:
    31	        raise ValueError("page numbers start at 1")
    32	    start = page * per_page
    33	    end = start + per_page
    34	    return Page(items=list(items[start:end]), number=page, per_page=per_page, total=len(items))

1	"""Page-number pagination helpers used by the catalog API."""
     2	from dataclasses import dataclass
     3	from math import ceil
     4	
     5	
     6	@dataclass(frozen=True)
     7	class Page:
     8	    items: list
     9	    number: int
    10	    per_page: int
    11	    total: int
    12	
    13	    @property
    14	    def pages(self) -> int:
    15	        return max(1, ceil(self.total / self.per_page))
    16	
    17	    @property
    18	    def has_next(self) -> bool:
    19	        return self.number < self.pages
    20	
    21	    @property
    22	    def has_prev(self) -> bool:
    23	        return self.number > 1
    24	
    25	
    26	def paginate(items, page=1, per_page=20):
    27	    """Return the 1-indexed ``page`` of ``items``."""
    28	    if per_page < 1:
    29	        raise ValueError("per_page must be positive")
    30	    if page < 1:
    31	        raise ValueError("page numbers start at 1")
    32	    start = page * per_page
    33	    end = start + per_page
    34	    return Page(items=list(items[start:end]), number=page, per_page=per_page, total=len(items))
